thirdPartyMobilityCard: final price may include provider commission and must not be assumed from Lidl direct tariff
rule: Apply standard Lidl direct prices (0.29 EUR/kWh AC, 0.39 EUR/kWh DC) to direct/card/QR payment. When the user selects or uses Lidl Plus and the official Lidl Plus promotional offer remains active, apply 0.18 EUR/kWh AC and 0.29 EUR/kWh DC. Never apply these prices to third-party mobility-card billing or non-Lidl partner sites. If the promotional offer can no longer be confirmed from a successfully fetched official Lidl Plus source, fall back to the standard direct tariff.
